description.value: Champions Guild Automation: Powerful Recovery: Hit Point Dice you roll to regain Hit Points count 1s and 2s as 3s (the module sets it on the roll). Sanguine Feast: once per turn when you hit a Bloodied creature that isn't a Construct or Undead with an attack roll, the module offers to spend a Hit Point Die and regain the roll + your Constitution modifier. Proficiency Bonus times per Long Rest - the feat's uses.

automation.notes: Champions Guild Automation: Powerful Recovery on Hit Point Die rolls and the Sanguine Feast offer on hits are module rules (PB/LR uses).
